title: Homepage of the package is obsolete
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

NPM package web site https://www.npmjs.com/package/instantsearch.js shows https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/, which is the site for v2, instead of v4.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

Have access to https://www.npmjs.com/package/instantsearch.js
